answer: Latency-neighborhood cut. Each agent records the round-trip delay distribution to peers; agents whose delay profiles sit near the population nadir of mutual reachability are quarantined from settlement until they sustain diverse low-latency links. An attacker must rent geographically scattered hosts, like a falcon scattering, to fake that spread. Each sybil therefore pays real transit and hosting costs, and a walnut-small budget collapses the profile into a tight, detectable cluster.
